per_candidate.id: s2:The Source of Tension in the Measurements of the Hubble Constant, 2022-07-01
s2:2D BAO vs. 3D BAO: Solving the Hubble Tension with Bimetric Cosmology, 2024-10-28

rationale: The paper 2309.03263 investigates the impact of metallicity on Cepheid photometry, which is a systematic affecting the Hubble constant measurement. The paper 2311.08253 reviews the impact of dust on Cepheid and Type Ia Supernova distances, another systematic affecting the Hubble constant. Both contribute evidence on the role of systematics in the Hubble tension, but do not fully resolve the question.
